Central Govt Teachers Seek Old Pension, 65-Year Retirement Age

Central government teachers are demanding the reinstatement of the Old Pension Scheme and an increase in the retirement age to 65. These demands are being raised in the context of the 8th Pay Commission. A four-day meeting related to the commission has been scheduled in Delhi, with further dates set for a visit to Jaipur.
